title: Cracking Enigma at Bletchley Park
hook: Crossword champions broke Hitler's secret codes.

scenes.text: Deep in the Buckinghamshire countryside, an eccentric Victorian mansion called Bletchley Park housed Britain's greatest codebreaking minds.
scenes.imagePrompt: Red brick Victorian manor house at Bletchley Park surrounded by green lawns and wooden military huts under overcast skies. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Deep in the Buckinghamshire countryside, an eccentric Victorian mansion called Bletchley Park housed Britain's greatest codebreaking minds.

scenes.text: Recruits weren't just mathematicians—they included chess masters, linguists, and crossword champions scouted through national newspapers.
scenes.imagePrompt: Wooden desk inside a dimly lit codebreaker hut with paper crossword puzzles, pencils, and teacups beside Morse code telegraph keys. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Recruits weren't just mathematicians—they included chess masters, linguists, and crossword champions scouted through national newspapers.

scenes.text: Every day, German military units scrambled their secret orders using Enigma machines with 150 million million possible rotor settings.
scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up of a three-rotor German Enigma cipher machine in an oak case showing brass alphabet keyboard and plugboard wires. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Every day, German military units scrambled their secret orders using Enigma machines with 150 million million possible rotor settings.

scenes.text: To break the cipher before midnight, Alan Turing designed the 'Bombe': an electromechanical machine of spinning red and black drums.
scenes.imagePrompt: Massive electromechanical Turing Bombe machine with dozens of rotating colored drums and bundles of copper wire inside a timber hut. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: To break the cipher before midnight, Alan Turing designed the 'Bombe': an electromechanical machine of spinning red and black drums.

scenes.text: Operating in freezing wooden huts called Hut 6 and Hut 8, ten thousand staff deciphered intercepted signals that shortened the war by two years.
scenes.imagePrompt: Interior of Hut 8 with long wooden trestle tables stacked with teleprinter paper tapes, cubbyholes, and filing cabinets. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Operating in freezing wooden huts called Hut 6 and Hut 8, ten thousand staff deciphered intercepted signals that shortened the war by two years.

scenes.text: Staff swore absolute secrecy and told no one—not even their spouses—for thirty years. Could you keep that secret?
